classification: Archive annotations reconstructed from recorded agent/tool outcomes; not replacement raw logs.

retainedInitialFailures.outcome: Initial compile failed because tests passed [UInt8] where the draft required JPEGBytes; data-reader-tests-retry.log retains the corrected 42-test pass.
Initial #require expansion failed because the throwing call was not marked with try; final integrated qualification is in the parent report.
Initial test compared all Darwin descriptor flags, including unrelated kernel bit0x10000; test corrected to O_NONBLOCK mask.
Second test run failed because a test-local variable shadowed an installer fixture; verified run/report retained separately.
Early release-probe revision exited133 after the deprecated typed Data.withUnsafeBytes overload inferred Int; corrected to explicit UnsafeRawBufferPointer.

reportedAttemptsWithoutSeparateRawReceip.outcome: Rejected by ordinary compiler feature support; no experimental flags adopted. Source retained; standalone diagnostic output was not retained as a separate file. Confirmed by the audit agent.
Initial diagnostic compile omitted package identity and was rejected by package access control. Corrected commands are retained; first stderr was not retained separately.

Initial harness compile put maximumWorkers after maximumMemoryBytes; compiler required maximumWorkers to precede maximumMemoryBytes. The named log was reused for the successful rerun; no separate raw failure log remains.

The baseline CLI returned exit5/resourceLimitExceeded before timing because its workspace reservation was exceeded, including with --max-memory10737418240. The RSS script was corrected to use the native harness with explicit workspace limits; original named log was reused.

provisionalTimingTimeline.earlyExperiments: Coordinated local CPU slots were used. Original logs/metadata are preserved without retrospectively asserting universal host quiescence.
provisionalTimingTimeline.laterDCT: Grouped4/grouped8, their repeats, three-way rotation and scalar512 timings are provisional. The user explicitly authorised collection despite a foreign Virtualization VM load; observed VM readings included474.4% and406.6%CPU. No foreign job was changed.
provisionalTimingTimeline.hostObservationLimit: Those CPU observations were tool-output snapshots, not a continuous or timestamped utilisation trace. Embedded execution timestamps, where present, are authoritative; filesystem mtimes are only file metadata.

ownershipProbeDecisions.span: Rejected as an ordinary-feature production route.
ownershipProbeDecisions.nsdataWindow: Initial probe established immutable snapshot/COW/slice behaviour under explicit pools, but did not prove immediate release without a pool.
ownershipProbeDecisions.nsdataBytesRelease: 0/32 immediate releases without a surrounding pool; bridge/factory-only pools were insufficient. Pooling pointer acquisition produced32/32 immediate releases; accepted interim solution.
ownershipProbeDecisions.cfdataPointer: CFDataGetBytePtr on retained immutable NSData passed32/32 immediate releases without a pool, using a normal toll-free cast. Accepted final direction, subsequently integrated by root.
ownershipProbeDecisions.portability: Only original-Data pointer identity is Apple-specific. Shared owner/range, snapshot, bytes, release and joined-read obligations remain universal; Linux was not executed here.

noLargeDefaultStreaming: Grouped windows and their new parallel pointer carrier were rejected and do not ship. Final large default decoding retains full coefficients/planes with bounded reconstruction scratch; explicit one-worker sequential greyscale streams1024blocks.
